fnol_text: My name is Gabriel Vasquez and I live at 446 Ashford Court, Ashland, OR 97519. You can reach me on (555) 617-6434 or gabriel.vasquez@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 16 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00012. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Vasquez on (555) 617-6434 to acknowledge the claim. Gabriel confirmed the loss date as 16 August 2024.
Site visit to 446 Ashford Court. Neighbour Nikhil Okafor was present and confirmed the timeline.
Gabriel sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
